coverageContext: Research model evaluated prospectively in European women aged 50–74. It does not reproduce an absolute-risk model, establish a screening recommendation, or replace assessment of high-penetrance variants.

Research model developed and evaluated in European samples. Reported evaluation overlaps development samples; GA does not reproduce the combined immune-cell/clinical model or claim independent diagnostic validation.

Type 1 diabetes association-weighted research score evaluated for cystic-fibrosis-related diabetes, not validated here as a general-population type 1 diabetes diagnostic model. Evaluation ancestry is unreported. GA does not determine diabetes type or treatment.

Research model of diabetes onset among people with cystic fibrosis and severe CFTR mutations and/or exocrine pancreatic insufficiency. It is not a cystic fibrosis diagnosis or a general-population diabetes score. Evaluation ancestry is unreported; GA does not estimate onset age, absolute hazard or treatment need.

Small Chinese study of early-pregnancy gestational diabetes. GA reports only the genetic component, not the combined clinical prediction model. East Asian evaluation means EUR comparisons are withheld; this cannot replace pregnancy glucose screening or clinical care.

Research model evaluated for radiographic and clinical hip osteoarthritis and hip replacement in European cohorts. Associations vary by cohort and endpoint; GA does not reproduce covariate-adjusted predictions or recommend surgery.
